thread:
Emily: FYI — quick bring-up summary for sapphire10b (fresh candidate). ran int8 and int6 microbench + GTN sample evals. posting highlights and a suggested rollout plan.

Emily: perf snapshot (prod-like workloads, batch=1, seq=1024):
```
int8 : throughput 12.3 req/s, p50 42ms, p95 150ms, p99 320ms, cost ~ $0.028 / 1k tokens
int6 : throughput 11.0 req/s, p50 48ms, p95 170ms, p99 360ms, cost ~ $0.022 / 1k tokens
fp16 : throughput 8.5 req/s, p50 65ms, p95 240ms, p99 520ms, cost ~ $0.045 / 1k tokens
```

Emily: quality (GTN sample, 10k inputs):
- fp16 baseline -> reference F1 0.821
- int8 -> F1 0.815 (-0.6 pts, ~0.7% relative)
- int6 -> F1 0.807 (-1.4 pts, ~1.7% relative)

Raj: thanks. rough unit-econ quick calc: assume 2k tokens per request average -> cost per request: int8 ~$0.056, int6 ~$0.044. So per 1M requests int8 ~$56k, int6 ~$44k (back-of-envelope).

Lucas: ops notes: int6 shows slightly worse p99 but lower cost. also saw occasional 503s at sustained burst in the int6 harness (small KV-cache edge case). created bug #ML-879. recommend fallback policy.

Marta: product ask — what's the user-visible delta? 0.7% F1 is borderline but maybe okay for lower-tier profiles. can we gate on request type? e.g., short-form completions vs longform?

Emily: yes we split by intent and length. short completions (<=3 turns, <=200 tokens) have near-zero delta. long multi-turn assistants show most of the regression.

Raj: proposal: default routing 70% int8, 30% int6 for public tier; cost-tier (cheap plan) route 90% int6 + 10% int8 as safety. product tier (SLA) -> fp16 or int8 pinned.

Lucas: rollout config I'll use (example):
```json
{"model":"sapphire10b","routing":{"int6":0.3,"int8":0.7},"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":5000}
```

Marta: gating criteria for GTN: 24h smoke, metric checks: F1 drop <=1.0 absolute, p99 latency increase <=20%, error rate <=0.2%. If fail -> rollback to int8.

Emily: additional notes:
- tuning: we can try mixed-int pipeline (int6 for prefix KV, int8 for decode) — could recover ~0.4 F1 pts, need infra changes.
- quant finetune (3-5k steps) likely recovers most of the int6 gap; cost/time estimate ~3 TPU days.

Raj: decision recs to present to GTN:
- immediate: canary 30% int8 / 70% int6 for cost-tier only (non-prod customers) until finetune.
- near-term: run 3k eval slices on product signals (50k samples) to validate where regressions occur.
- long-term: quant-finetune + mixed-int path then re-eval.

Lucas: ops checklist before canary: KV-cache patch for int6 (PR#452), canary infra quota bump, shadow traffic run for 6h. I'm scheduling for tonight 02:00 UTC.

Emily: tagging @Raj @Lucas @Marta — final ask: can someone own the 50k slice eval? Raj?

Raj: I can own the slice eval. will coordinate data pull with product. ETA 48h.

Marta: I'll prepare GTN note + acceptance doc. adding product hooks for user-facing alerting.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: sapphire10b-int6 -> 2024-06-12T02:00Z, samples=5000, owner=Lucas. Monitoring: model-latency, gtn-f1, errors.

Lucas: thanks — will post results in this thread after 6h shadow + canary.

Emily: closing for now. high-level recommendation: int8 as default for quality-sensitive routes; int6 for aggressive cost-tier with guarded fallbacks and plan for quant-finetune. :thumbsup:
